118564.name: Beis Chabad of North Oak Park
118564.note: Detroit Jewish News, 9 Nov 1990: Friends of Refugees of Eastern Europe, an affiliate of Michigan Chabad, 'established Bais Chabad of North Oak Park at the Northgate Clubhouse in mid-August', for Soviet immigrants, led by Rabbi Yosef Mishulovin. Where it has been (Jewish News): 'Friends of Refugees of Eastern Europe, an affiliate of Michigan Chabad, established Bais Chabad of North Oak Park at the Northgate Clubhouse in mid-August' (Nov 9 1990); listed at 25539 Briar Drive, Oak Park, Rabbi Yehoshua Morozow (Feb 22 1991); 'Bais Chabad of North Oak Park and F.R.E.E. have moved to new quarters. Shabbat morning services have moved to the Jimmy Prentis Morris Community Center' (June 28 1991). Now at 15401 W. 10 Mile Rd. (already in lubavitch.com's directory, Dec 2009).

earlier.where: the Northgate Clubhouse (North), Oak Park, where F.R.E.E. established it
